findings.title: Unreadable evidence gets the wrong diagnosis
findings.description: `main()` checks `result.considered === 0` before it checks the read errors collected in `problems`. If the readable records are all from another repository or have unknown bases while another evidence file or directory is unreadable, exit 2 says no review belongs to this checkout and omits the read failure that needs attention.
